correctness.rationale: Equality of prime factorization values is exactly equality of vector (gcd(e_i,alpha))_i. Taking lcm coordinatewise gives gcd(L,alpha) by primewise max-min identity. Conversely gcd(L,alpha)=gcd(L,beta) implies every exponent gcd agrees. Divisors d|L index all distinct values; phi(L/d) counts parameters in one period; comparing inputs L and L+T proves L divides every period. Independent gcd tuple tests validated every fiber for exponent tuples of small support. Result holds n>1 and positive alpha.
